articles.summary: CONWAY, Ark., Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Home BancShares, Inc. (NYSE: HOMB) (the “Company”), parent company of Centennial Bank (“Centennial”), announced today that its Board of Directors increased the number of shares authorized for repurchase under the Company’s stock repurchase program and declared its regular quarterly cash dividend. On October 16, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company increased the number of shares of the Company’s common stock authorized for repurchase under its stock repurchase program to 20,000,000 shares. The program was originally approved by the Board in January 2008 and was most recently amended in January 2025. As of October 16, 2026, approximately 13,450,123 shares remained available under the existing authorization; therefore, the Board’s action increased the number of shares available for repurchase by 6,549,877.
